		CNA = { transfer_state = 364 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 365 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 816 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 816 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 261 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 261 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 393 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 393 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 394 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 394 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 395 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 395 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 396 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 396 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 391 = { is_owned_by = USA } }
		CNA = { transfer_state = 391 }
	}
	CNA = { set_capital = { state = 360 } }
	CNA = {
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = democratic
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		set_popularities = {
			neutrality = 10
			fascism = 5
			democratic = 65
			communism = 20
		}
	}
	CNA = {
		promote_character = USA_george_washington
		add_ideas = LR_CNA_continental_army
	}
	USA = {
		transfer_units_fraction = {
			target = CNA
			size = 0.4
			stockpile_ratio = 0.4
			navy_ratio = 0.2
			air_ratio = 0.3
		}
	}
	set_variable = { LR_cna_divs = USA.num_armies }
	add_to_variable = { LR_cna_divs = ENG.num_armies }
	multiply_variable = { LR_cna_divs = 0.5 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_cna_divs min = 20 max = 120 }
	CNA = {
		division_template = {
			name = "Continental Line"
			regiments = {
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 0 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 1 }
				infantry = { x = 2 y = 2 }
			}
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = infantry_equipment
			amount = 80000
		}
		add_manpower = 900000
		set_variable = { LR_cna_divs = USA.LR_cna_divs }
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = LR_cna_divs
			create_unit = {
				division = "division_template = \"Continental Line\" start_experience_factor = 0.5"
				owner = CNA
			}
		}
	}
	CNA = {
		declare_war_on = {
			target = USA
			type = annex_everything
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { CNA = { has_war_with = ENG } } }
		CNA = {
			declare_war_on = {
				target = ENG
				type = annex_everything
			}
		}
	}
}

lr_world_balkans = {
	set_global_flag = LR_balkan_war
	if = {
		limit = { YUG = { is_in_faction = yes } }
		YUG = { leave_faction = yes }
	}
	YUG = { create_faction = LR_balkan_pact }
	if = {
		limit = { GRE = { exists = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { GRE = { is_in_faction = yes } }
			GRE = { leave_faction = yes }
		}
		YUG = { add_to_faction = GRE }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ROM = { exists = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { ROM = { is_in_faction = yes } }
			ROM = { leave_faction = yes }
		}
		YUG = { add_to_faction = ROM }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			YUG = { exists = yes }
			BUL = { exists = yes }
			NOT = { YUG = { has_war_with = BUL } }
		}
		YUG = {
			declare_war_on = {
				target = BUL
				type = annex_everything
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			GRE = { exists = yes }
			BUL = { exists = yes }
			NOT = { GRE = { has_war_with = BUL } }
		}
		GRE = {
			declare_war_on = {
				target = BUL
				type = annex_everything
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			ROM = { exists = yes }
			BUL = { exists = yes }
			NOT = { ROM = { has_war_with = BUL } }
		}
		ROM = {
			declare_war_on = {
				target = BUL
				type = annex_everything
			}
		}
	}
}

lr_bulgaria_beats_serbia = {
	if = {
		limit = { YUG = { is_in_faction = yes } }
		YUG = { leave_faction = yes }
	}
	BUL = { white_peace = YUG }
	if = {
		limit = { 105 = { is_owned_by = YUG } }
		MNT = { transfer_state = 105 }
	}
	MNT = { set_capital = { state = 105 } }
	MNT = {
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = neutrality
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		set_popularities = {
			neutrality = 70
			fascism = 10
			democratic = 10
			communism = 10
		}
	}
	BUL = {
		set_autonomy = {
			target = YUG
			autonomous_state = autonomy_puppet
		}
	}
	set_global_flag = LR_bulgaria_beat_YUG
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = LR_bulgaria_beat_YUG
			has_global_flag = LR_bulgaria_beat_ROM
			has_global_flag = LR_bulgaria_beat_GRE
		}
		clr_global_flag = LR_balkan_war
		set_global_flag = LR_bulgaria_hegemon
		news_event = { id = lr_gnews.17 days = 1 }
	}
	news_event = { id = lr_world.112 }
}

lr_world_league = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ENG = {
				exists = yes
				is_subject = no
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ENG = { is_in_faction = yes } }
			ENG = { leave_faction = yes }
		}
		ENG = { create_faction = LR_imperial_league }
		set_global_flag = LR_imperial_league
		if = {
			limit = {
				AUS = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { AUS = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				AUS = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = AUS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				GER = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { GER = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				GER = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = GER }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				BAY = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { BAY = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				BAY = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = BAY }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				UKR = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { UKR = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				UKR = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = UKR }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				BLR = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { BLR = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				BLR = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = BLR }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				EST = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { EST = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				EST = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = EST }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				LAT = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { LAT = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				LAT = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = LAT }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				LIT = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { LIT = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				LIT = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = LIT }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				GEO = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { GEO = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				GEO = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = GEO }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				ARM = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { ARM = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				ARM = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = ARM }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				AZR = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { AZR = { is_in_faction = yes } }
				AZR = { leave_faction = yes }
			}
			ENG = { add_to_faction = AZR }
		}
	}
}

			}

				GRE = { white_peace = PREV }
			}
		}

			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				leave_faction = yes
			}
			every_enemy_country = {
				ROM = { white_peace = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { BUL = { exists = yes } }
		BUL = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				leave_faction = yes
			}
			every_enemy_country = {
				BUL = { white_peace = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			BUL = { exists = yes }
			SOV = { exists = yes }
		}
		SOV = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = BUL
				autonomous_state = autonomy_puppet
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_flag = LR_balkan_beat_bulgaria
}

lr_balkan_fall_serbia = {

			}

				target = YUG

			}
		}
	}
}

lr_league_russia_joins = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = LR_imperial_league
			ROOT = { tag = FRA }
			FROM = {
				OR = { tag = ENG tag = AUS tag = GER tag = BAY tag = UKR tag = BLR tag = EST tag = LAT tag = LIT tag = GEO tag = ARM tag = AZR tag = BUL }
				OR = {
					tag = ENG
					is_in_faction_with = ENG
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				SOV = {
					exists = yes
					is_subject = no
				}
			}
			log = "LR: France declared war on the League, Russia follows"
			FROM = {
				SOV = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = PREV } }
						declare_war_on = {
							target = PREV
							type = annex_everything
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = LR_balkan_pact_won }
			if = {
				limit = {
					YUG = {
						exists = yes
						is_subject = no
					}
				}
				set_global_flag = LR_balkan_front
				FROM = {
					YUG = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = PREV } }
							declare_war_on = {
								target = PREV
								type = annex_everything
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					GRE = {
						exists = yes
						is_subject = no
					}
				}
				set_global_flag = LR_balkan_front
				FROM = {
					GRE = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = PREV } }
							declare_war_on = {
								target = PREV
								type = annex_everything
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					ROM = {
						exists = yes
						is_subject = no
					}
				}
				set_global_flag = LR_balkan_front
				FROM = {
					ROM = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = PREV } }
							declare_war_on = {
								target = PREV
								type = annex_everything
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

lr_pick_victor = {
	clear_variable = global.LR_victor
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 3000 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 2000 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 1500 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 1000 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 700 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 500 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 300 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 200 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 100 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 50 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 20 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 5 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = PREV thousands > 0 } } }
			set_variable = { global.LR_victor = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.LR_victor } }
		set_variable = { global.LR_victor = FROM }
	}
}

lr_german_exile = {
	if = {
		limit = { GER = { any_owned_state = { NOT = { is_on_continent = europe } } } }
		GER = {
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_on_continent = europe } }
				GEX = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
		}
		GEX = {
			if = {
				limit = { owns_state = 773 }
				set_capital = { state = 773 }
			}
			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = neutrality
				elections_allowed = no
			}
		}
		news_event = { id = lr_gnews.32 days = 1 }
	}
}

lr_back_to_start_FRA = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = LR_start_owner
			NOT = { has_state_flag = LR_start_FRA }
		}
		var:LR_start_owner = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
}

lr_back_to_start_SOV = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = LR_start_owner
			NOT = { has_state_flag = LR_start_SOV }
		}
		var:LR_start_owner = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
}

lr_france_defeated = {
	# What France took in war goes back to its owners in 1936.
	lr_back_to_start_FRA = yes
	if = {
		limit = { 28 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
		if = {
			limit = { GER = { exists = yes } }
			GER = { transfer_state = 28 }
		}
		else = {
			var:global.LR_victor = { transfer_state = 28 }
		}
	}
	# Corsica to Sardinia, or to a united Italy, if either fought France.
	if = {
		limit = { 1 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					tag = ITA
					AND = {
						has_global_flag = LR_italy_united
						OR = { tag = PAP tag = TOS tag = TTS }
					}
				}
			}
			transfer_state = 1
		}
	}
	# 알제리
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.LR_victor = { has_government = neutrality } }
		if = {
			limit = { 459 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			var:global.LR_victor = { transfer_state = 459 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 460 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			var:global.LR_victor = { transfer_state = 460 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 513 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			var:global.LR_victor = { transfer_state = 513 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 514 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			var:global.LR_victor = { transfer_state = 514 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.LR_victor = { has_government = communism } }
		if = {
			limit = { 459 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 459 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 460 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 460 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 513 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 513 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 514 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 514 }
		}
		ALG = {
			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = communism
				elections_allowed = no
			}
			set_popularities = {
				neutrality = 10
				fascism = 10
				democratic = 10
				communism = 70
			}
		}
		ALG = { set_cosmetic_tag = LR_ALG_red }
		var:global.LR_victor = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = ALG
				autonomous_state = autonomy_puppet
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.LR_victor = { has_government = democratic } }
		if = {
			limit = { 459 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 459 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 460 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 460 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 513 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 513 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 514 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 514 }
		}
		ALG = {
			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = democratic
				elections_allowed = no
			}
			set_popularities = {
				neutrality = 10
				fascism = 10
				democratic = 70
				communism = 10
			}
		}
		ALG = { set_cosmetic_tag = LR_ALG_free }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.LR_victor = { has_government = fascism } }
		if = {
			limit = { 459 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 459 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 460 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 460 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 513 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 513 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 514 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			ALG = { transfer_state = 514 }
		}
		ALG = {
			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = fascism
				elections_allowed = no
			}
			set_popularities = {
				neutrality = 10
				fascism = 70
				democratic = 10
				communism = 10
			}
		}
		ALG = { set_cosmetic_tag = LR_ALG_rk }
		var:global.LR_victor = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = ALG
				autonomous_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat
			}
		}
	}
	# 튀니지
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.LR_victor = { has_government = neutrality } }
		if = {
			limit = { 458 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			var:global.LR_victor = { transfer_state = 458 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 665 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			var:global.LR_victor = { transfer_state = 665 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.LR_victor = { has_government = communism } }
		if = {
			limit = { 458 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			TUN = { transfer_state = 458 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 665 = { is_owned_by = FRA } }
			TUN = { transfer_state = 665 }
		}

			set_politics = {
				ruling_party = communism
				elections_allowed = no
			}
			set_popularities = {
				neutrality = 10

				democratic = 10

			}

		var:global.LR_victor = {
			set_autonomy = {

lr_world_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ROOT = { tag = BAY }
			FRA = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			FROM = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { tag = SOV }
					is_in_faction_with = FRA
				}
				OR = {
					tag = FRA
					is_in_faction_with = FRA
					is_subject_of = FRA
				}
			}
		}
		FRA = { set_country_flag = LR_bavaria_defeated }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			ROOT = { tag = SOV }
			FRA = { has_war_with = SOV }
			FROM = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { tag = SOV }
					is_in_faction_with = FRA
				}
				OR = {
					tag = FRA
					is_in_faction_with = FRA
					is_subject_of = FRA
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = LR_russia_defeated
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			ROOT = { tag = FRA }
			NOT = { FROM = { tag = ALG } }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = LR_settled_france }
		}
		set_global_flag = LR_settled_france
		FRA = {
			lr_pick_victor = yes
			lr_france_defeated = yes
		}
	}
}

lr_separate_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { tag = FRA }
			FROM = { has_war_with = ROOT }
		}
		FROM = {
			start_peace_conference = {
				tag = ROOT
				score_factor = 1.0
				winner_scope = ALL
				loser_scope = LIMITED
			}
		}
	}
}

lr_fra_victory_settlement = {
	log = "LR: French victory settlement for [ROOT.GetTag]"
	# The European lands this kind of France keeps.
	if = {
		limit = { FRA = { OR = { has_country_flag = LR_route_empire has_country_flag = LR_route_red } } }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 1 state = 2 state = 6 state = 7 state = 8 state = 14 state = 15 state = 16 state = 17 state = 18 state = 19 state = 20 state = 21 state = 22 state = 23 state = 24 state = 25 state = 26 state = 27 state = 28 state = 29 state = 30 state = 31 state = 32 state = 33 state = 34 state = 35 state = 36 state = 42 state = 51 state = 56 state = 103 state = 114 state = 158 state = 162 state = 163 state = 165 state = 735 state = 785 state = 806 state = 836 state = 845 state = 851 state = 852 state = 853 state = 977 state = 980 state = 1082 state = 1083 state = 1084 state = 1085 state = 1089 state = 1111 state = 1112 state = 1129 state = 1130 state = 1132 state = 1133 state = 1134 state = 1135 state = 1136 state = 1137 state = 1138 state = 1407 } }
			FRA = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { FRA = { has_government = democratic } }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 1 state = 14 state = 15 state = 16 state = 17 state = 18 state = 19 state = 20 state = 21 state = 22 state = 23 state = 24 state = 25 state = 26 state = 27 state = 28 state = 29 state = 30 state = 31 state = 32 state = 33 state = 735 state = 785 state = 806 state = 851 state = 1129 state = 1130 state = 1407 } }
			FRA = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { FRA = { has_government = communism } }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 1 state = 6 state = 8 state = 14 state = 15 state = 16 state = 17 state = 18 state = 19 state = 20 state = 21 state = 22 state = 23 state = 24 state = 25 state = 26 state = 27 state = 28 state = 29 state = 30 state = 31 state = 32 state = 33 state = 34 state = 735 state = 785 state = 806 state = 845 state = 851 state = 977 state = 980 state = 1129 state = 1130 state = 1133 state = 1407 } }
			FRA = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 1 state = 6 state = 8 state = 14 state = 15 state = 16 state = 17 state = 18 state = 19 state = 20 state = 21 state = 22 state = 23 state = 24 state = 25 state = 26 state = 27 state = 28 state = 29 state = 30 state = 31 state = 32 state = 33 state = 34 state = 42 state = 51 state = 114 state = 158 state = 735 state = 785 state = 806 state = 845 state = 851 state = 977 state = 980 state = 1089 state = 1111 state = 1112 state = 1129 state = 1130 state = 1133 state = 1134 state = 1135 state = 1136 state = 1137 state = 1407 } }
			FRA = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	# Britain is the exception: its crown flees to Ottawa with the empire (lr_settle_britain).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { tag = ENG } }
	# Outside Europe France annexes everything that is not the loser's own core.
	if = {
		limit = { tag = GER }
		lr_german_exile = yes
	}
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_on_continent = europe }
			NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
		}
		FRA = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	# The loser's overseas subjects become French dominions; Spain's and Portugal's Americas go free instead.
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_subject_of = ROOT
			capital_scope = { NOT = { is_on_continent = europe } }
		}
		ROOT = { end_puppet = PREV }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = FRA }
			FRA = { white_peace = PREV }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						ROOT = { OR = { tag = SPR tag = CRL tag = ESR tag = POR } }
						capital_scope = { OR = { is_on_continent = north_america is_on_continent = south_america } }
					}
				}
			}
			FRA = {
				set_autonomy = {
					target = PREV
					autonomous_state = autonomy_dominion
				}
			}
		}
	}
	}
}

# A country outside Europe that falls to France: the British empire and the Iberian Americas only make peace,
# anything else is annexed.
lr_fra_overseas_settlement = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_subject_of = ENG
				is_subject_of = CAN
				is_subject_of = SPR
				is_subject_of = CRL
				is_subject_of = ESR
				is_subject_of = POR
				tag = CAN tag = AST tag = NZL tag = SAF tag = USA tag = RAJ tag = MAL tag = MEX tag = COL tag = PRU tag = ARG tag = GUA tag = CHL tag = VEN tag = CUB tag = BRA tag = CNA
			}
		}
		FRA = { white_peace = ROOT }
	}
	else = {
		FRA = { country_event = { id = lr_world.92 } }
	}
}
